 So a repeat of the last U19 final and it will be India vs Pakistan once again. The latter won the last time, who will come out on top in this one? For all the answers, do join us nice and early on the 14th of November. Till then keep following this platform for all your cricketing drug. For now it's bye bye from all of us here. Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani | Player of the Match and India captain: [On scoring a well-compiled 93, his second half-century of the tournament, and missing out on a hundred] Yeah, definitely disappointed but the team got over the line, that’s what matters. [On his approach to the innings and playing aggressively while chasing the target] I was just trying to play freely and play my game and just play the situation. And it worked out well. [On the pitch conditions and whether he would have chosen to bat first] Yeah, I think again it’s a good toss to lose. We were consistent on what we had planned and that’s what we are looking for. We have to be consistent for a longer period of time to be ahead at the game. [On the spinners’ performance in the middle overs, with Manal and Yashbardhan keeping the scoring rate under control] Yeah, they bowled really well. That’s what we are looking for, to bowl tight overs in the middle. And they bowled really well. [On the upcoming Pakistan versus India final and the anticipation surrounding the contest] Yeah, it’s going to be a good final and everyone’s waiting for that. And yeah, hopefully we put (up a) good show. Sohail Khan | Afghanistan captain: [On the loss after choosing to bat first and posting 227, with the total ultimately proving insufficient] Yes, it was not good enough runs for us on this flat wicket. The wicket didn't change, so the result is the same. [On the bowling plan and what was told to the bowlers while defending 227] Wicket is very flat. We focused on our bowlers to keep good areas, but wicket's very flat, very flat, very difficult. [On Afghanistan reaching the Under-19 Asia Cup semi-final for the first time since 2019 and the positives from the campaign] Yeah, we played very well in this tournament. Inshallah, we are focused on improvement for us. Inshallah, we will do our best in all tournaments. 15:11 Local Time, 11:11 GMT, 16:41 IST: Such an easy chase from India U19. Once Afghanistan didn't get the early wickets, it was always a herculean task for them. The Indian openers then went on the attack with their skipper - Lakshya Rajesh Raichandani leading the way. He was the aggressor as Aaryavir Sehwag took his time. The openers put on 117 before Sehwag fell right after his 50. VK Vineeth came out at 3 and knocked the ball around en route to his fifty as he finished it off with a six off Noor Ali Niazi. Afghanistan were never allowed to settle even though it must be said that the pitch eased out in the afternoon as it has done throughout the tournament. The only disappointment would be Raichandani not going on to make his hundred. Stay tuned for the post-match stuff.... 36.5 6 Noor Ali Niazi to VK Vineeth, SIX , India U19 saunter to the final. It's a short of length delivery on off, VK Vineeth's weight is on the front foot, he stays there and pulls meatily over long-on. Flies all the way and that's the game 36.4 F Noor Ali Niazi to VK Vineeth, FOUR , 50 for VK Vineeth. Gets there with a good back foot punch. It's a short of length delivery outside off, Vineeth with a high elbow and the timing is great as it beats cover and mid-off 36.3 Noor Ali Niazi to VK Vineeth, no run, good delivery. On a short of length and moves away, lands around leg and seams away to beat the back foot poke 36.2 Noor Ali Niazi to Yashbardhan Chauhan, 1 run, good length and nips back in to off, Yashbardhan Chauhan gets forward to nudge, the bat turns in his hand, they take a quick single to mid-on 36.1 Noor Ali Niazi to Yashbardhan Chauhan, no run, good length outside off, Yashbardhan Chauhan goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to punch to backward point Noor Ali Niazi [7.0-0-47-1] is back into the attack Over 36 219-2 1 4 4 1 0 0 ( 10 runs) VK Vineeth 47 (59) Yashbardhan Chauhan 15 (12) Sohail Khan 9-1-56-1 Over Summary View all overs 35.6 Sohail Khan to VK Vineeth, no run, fired full on the stumps, VK Vineeth gets forward to drive it back to Sohail Khan 35.5 Sohail Khan to VK Vineeth, no run, slower and good length on off, VK Vineeth goes on the back foot and makes room to punch to cover 35.4 Sohail Khan to Yashbardhan Chauhan, 1 run, full and quicker on off, Yashbardhan Chauhan gets forward to drive past the bowler 35.3 4 Sohail Khan to Yashbardhan Chauhan, FOUR , deft touch. Fired full outside off, Yashbardhan Chauhan opens the face of the bat and guides it well wide of short third man to his left. Consecutive fours 35.2 4 Sohail Khan to Yashbardhan Chauhan, FOUR , slower and fuller outside off, Yashbardhan Chauhan gets forward and lofts through the line, mid-off is up and that runs away 35.1 Sohail Khan to VK Vineeth, 1 run, flat good length on off, VK Vineeth goes on the back foot and makes room to punch it to sweeper cover Time for a drink. Just the final formalities left now. India U19 well on their way.
